agent.problem: Stop 3, card 5 quotes "Your MOTHER is in the lobby", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

agent.problem: The walkthrough covers whom the unforgivable blasphemy is against and that it will never be forgiven, but no card covers the rest of Mark 3:29: "he is guilty of eternal sin." This leaves out a key part of Jesus' warning.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

agent.problem: The modern joke scenario hinges on the baker's mother appearing in the lobby. Although it is set in an adult meeting, it is still a joke scenario about a parent.

rule.text: No jokes or scenarios about school, parents or anything aimed at kids.

agent.problem: Four of the stop's five choice cards are multiple choice, while the only other type is a single true-or-false card. Multiple choice therefore dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
